verdict.rationale: Cline's web-based Kanban task board and hub-based scheduled agents (which persist across process restarts and run independently of any terminal session) suggest tasks could be monitored/continued from a browser on a different device, but no evidence explicitly confirms starting a task on one device and resuming/continuing it from another device or browser as a first-class workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device session handoff/sync, and independent confirmation that a task started locally (e.g., in VS Code) can be picked up mid-flight from the Kanban web UI on another machine.
